notes: Governing faculty documents are saved (AFAPM Sections E and F and Appendix 3; the CSU Parental Leave Policy), so missing = false (the no-policy coding (`missing`) not triggered).

Source precedence: AFAPM F.3.16 and F.3.17 (revised 2016-08-05) make Special Leave with pay for the STD elimination period mandatory ('will be granted with pay'; 'must be granted'); the 2015 Policy Library text and the HR Manual narrative still say 'in the department head's discretion'. Coded by the later governing manual, flagged conflicting_sources (c3).

Birth parent chain: sick/annual leave and Special Leave with pay for the 10-working-day STD elimination period (within) -> STD childbirth incapacity 6 weeks (8 caesarean) at 100% -> Parental Leave 3 work weeks -> FML remainder to 12 weeks (accrued leave or LWOP) -> discretionary additional time off; FML alongside from the start.

Non-birth parent chain: Parental Leave 3 work weeks (any time within the first year) with FML alongside -> FML remainder to 12 weeks (accrued leave or LWOP) -> discretionary additional time off; Colorado FCA leave for care of a civil-union/domestic partner runs concurrently with FML.

Fringe-pool reimbursement to departments (up to 12 weeks of salary for the birth mother's sick, annual and parental leave; 'up to 16 weeks' and 'up to 9 weeks' in the HR table) is internal funding, not an employee benefit, so not coded as a component or cap; only the table's teaching-relief item is coded (c6), under its literal 'Non-Tenure Track Faculty' header, flagged summary_only and ambiguous.
Annual leave accrues only to 12-month appointees (c9, not main campus); 9-month faculty have only discretionary limited leave (c17).

Documents cited but not saved: CSU Cost Share Faculty and Administrative Professional Privileges and Benefits Summary Plan (SPD) booklet / Academic Faculty and Administrative Professional Benefits and Privileges Handbook (STD and LTD terms, STD eligibility); HR Manual Section 1 (FML, extended sick leave); Leave Reporting Policy / Leave Reporting Procedures; Parental Leave Application form; Office of the Provost page linked under 'Other Helpful Resources for New Parents'; C.R.S. 8-13.3-203 (Colorado Family Care Act) text; AFAPM Sections C, D, G and K and department codes (cited for non-leave matters).
